svg.text: Robotics Project #13 · Assembly guide 6/7 · step by step
hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
Build one step at a time. Colour = the new part, grey = already done. ! = grown-up step.
Ping-pong ball, sheet 4 hat brim + bottle
Glue the ball on the neck, brim and cap
Head sits straight; draw a face.
Stand both feet on the table, glue hands
Barrow wheels touch the table; feet
Holder + switch under tray; wires along
Wires do not touch the legs or cranks.
